title: Do LLMs Understand Social Knowledge? Evaluating the Sociability of Large Language Models with the SOCKET Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models using binary classification tasks to detect whether a given sentence implies social biases or harmful stereotypes, utilizing datasets like Social Bias Frames and Implicit Hate.
Testing models on a pairwise comparison task (using the neutralizing-bias-pairs dataset) where the model must identify which of two given sentences exhibits subjective bias.
Assessing model performance on binary classification tasks to detect if a sentence is sexist, utilizing datasets such as the Social Bias Frames (sexyn task).

Evaluating zero-shot and fine-tuned models on their ability to classify identity-directed abuse and specific hateful contexts like white grievance hate, using datasets like Jigsaw and Contextual Abuse.
